task.title: Implement greeting shout mode
task.description_markdown: Implement `--shout` in the greeting CLI according to `specs/greeting.md`. Uppercase the complete final greeting in shout mode; preserve exact default and named behavior without it; reject unsupported arguments; add deterministic tests for named/default shout behavior, unchanged behavior, and argument rejection; keep the CLI dependency-free and Ruby 3.4-compatible; run `bin/check`.

step.name: Publish
step.instruction: Never change local history or content. Validate accepted predecessor evidence and the approved exact base, ordered commits, tip, trees, paths, recomputed binary diff digest, clean state, linear topology, canonical KOS-Task trailers, and required-check evidence; mismatch returns review_invalid. Fetch the default branch. Treat an exact reviewed remote tip and sequence as already published; push the exact tip without force only when the remote equals the reviewed base; a remote matching neither returns base_moved without mutation. Fetch after every push result and report published only after observing the exact approved sequence remotely.
